character: A personal blog for one author's long-form HTML reports, read for pleasure by a small circle who come back to talk about them. Warm paper, soft ink and a serif voice for everything that is read (titles, comments, letters to the author); a quiet system sans for everything that is used (navigation, buttons, dates, hints). One deep pine accent marks only what can be clicked. The report sits on the page like a sheet laid on paper, and the comments read as people talking, not as a form. The admin is the same house's back office for one expert: the same paper and serif page titles, sans everywhere else, hairline cards, list-first pages with the main action at the top right. Danger is rare and unmistakable.

colours.name: --bg
colours.use: Page paper on html, behind everything that is not a card; the site header is transparent over it. Warm off-white in light, warm near-black in dark.

colours.name: --surface
colours.use: The raised surface: the feedback letter card, admin cards, text inputs, textareas, selects and neutral buttons. White sheet on paper in light, one warm step up in dark.

colours.name: --surface-2
colours.use: The sunken tint: hover fills of quiet and neutral buttons and of table rows, the current sidebar item, the draft pill, page-level empty states, inline code and the avatar placeholder. text 14.53:1 light / 11.79:1 dark.

colours.name: --text
colours.use: Ink: titles, comment and letter bodies, logins, the author's name, nav links, archive titles, text on every tint. 16.13:1 on bg and 16.97:1 on surface in light; 14.80:1 on bg and 13.50:1 on surface in dark.

colours.name: --text-muted
colours.use: Dates, meta lines, hints, reaction counts, the archive date eyebrow and numbers line, disclosures, table headers, dt, the lede, empty-state text. Light 5.56:1 on bg, 5.86:1 on surface, 5.01:1 on surface-2, 4.96 on accent-soft, 5.03 on danger-soft, 5.16 on ok-soft. Dark 7.12 on bg, 6.50 on surface, 5.67 on surface-2, 5.57 on accent-soft, 5.92 on danger-soft, 5.55 on ok-soft.

colours.name: --border
colours.use: The edge of every control: neutral buttons, inputs, selects, textareas and the file-selector button. Light 3.57:1 on bg, 3.75 on surface, 3.21 on surface-2. Dark 4.17 on bg, 3.81 on surface, 3.32 on surface-2.

colours.name: --divider
colours.use: Decorative hairlines: the header's bottom edge, the reactions row's top rule, separators between top-level comments, archive rows and own letters, table rules, card edges, the page-head rule, the report frame edge and the avatar ring. Never the only edge of a control.

colours.name: --thread
colours.use: The 1px reply line down the left of .replies, one step stronger than --divider.

colours.name: --link
colours.use: Inline links in pine with an underline. Visited links keep this colour. Light 6.02 on bg, 6.34 on surface, 5.43 on surface-2. Dark 9.01 on bg, 8.22 on surface, 7.18 on surface-2.

colours.name: --accent
colours.use: Pine: the fill of every primary button (Sign in with GitHub, Post comment, Post reply, Send to the author, Send reply, Upload, Upload a report, Publish), the text of the Author badge, an open Reply summary, and the author-reply rule. Boundary contrast 6.02 on bg in light and 9.01 in dark.

colours.name: --accent-hover
colours.use: Primary fill on hover, and the link colour while pressed. on-accent on it 8.75:1 light, 10.41:1 dark; on surface-2 7.49 light.

colours.name: --on-accent
colours.use: Text on --accent and --accent-hover: 6.34 and 8.75 in light, 8.43 and 10.41 in dark.

colours.name: --accent-soft
colours.use: The Author badge fill and the ::selection fill. accent on it 5.37:1 light, 7.05:1 dark; text 14.39 light, 11.58 dark.

colours.name: --danger
colours.use: The fill of danger buttons (Remove for everyone, Block @login, Delete this report permanently), the text of the Remove and Block summaries and of the blocked badge, and the edge of the confirm tray, the error notice and invalid fields. Light 6.25 on bg, 5.63 on surface-2, 5.64 on danger-soft. Dark 9.38 on bg, 7.47 on surface-2, 7.79 on danger-soft.

colours.name: --danger-hover
colours.use: Danger fill on hover. on-danger on it 8.96:1 light, 10.91:1 dark.

colours.name: --on-danger
colours.use: Text on a danger fill: 6.57:1 light, 8.62:1 dark.

colours.name: --danger-soft
colours.use: The fill of the error notice, the open confirm tray and the blocked badge. text on it 14.57 light, 12.30 dark.

colours.name: --ok
colours.use: Success: the left edge of 'Sent to the author.' and .notice.ok, and the text and dot of the 'published' pill. On ok-soft 6.18:1 light, 8.01:1 dark.

colours.name: --ok-soft
colours.use: The fill of success notices and the 'published' pill. text on it about 15:1 light, 11.5:1 dark.

colours.name: --warning
colours.use: The edge of .notice.warning (no screen uses it today). On warning-soft 5.65:1 light, 8.50:1 dark.

colours.name: --warning-soft
colours.use: The fill of .notice.warning. text on it 15.16 light, 11.64 dark.

colours.name: --focus
colours.use: The keyboard focus ring on every focusable element, and the border of a focused field. At least 5.37:1 on every surface and tint in light and 7.02:1 in dark. The 2px offset leaves a paper-coloured gap, so the ring still reads around a pine button.

colours.name: Canvas (system colour, not a token)
colours.use: The background-color of iframe only, so a report whose scheme matches the frame shows the browser's own canvas, never the paper.

type.name: --font-serif
type.value: Charter, 'Bitstream Charter', 'Sitka Text', 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, Cambria, serif
type.use: The reading voice, for everything that is read: the brand, every h1 (reader titles, admin page titles, Not allowed), reader h2 section heads, archive titles, comment and letter bodies (.body), the removed placeholder, reader empty states, and the text people type into the comment, reply and feedback textareas. Installed faces only, since CSP refuses webfonts: Charter on Apple, Sitka Text on Windows, Bitstream Charter or Georgia elsewhere.

type.name: --font-sans
type.value: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif
type.use: Everything that is used: body default, nav, sidebar, buttons, inputs, selects, labels, bylines and dates, meta lines, hints, reaction counts, notices, badges, pills, tables, admin h2/h3 and admin body text.

type.name: --font-mono
type.value: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, Menlo, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
type.use: Inline code, the admin table's slug cells and the SHA-256 dd.

type.name: --text-xs
type.use: Badges, status pills, the archive date eyebrow (uppercase), table header cells (uppercase), the eyebrow h3 in blocked-account cards.

type.name: --text-sm
type.use: Buttons, nav, sidebar, bylines, the meta line, hints, reaction counts, labels, disclosures, notices, the archive numbers line, the views footnote, table body, dt, the file input.

type.name: --text-md
type.use: Body text, comment and letter bodies, inputs, selects and textareas (16px, so phones do not zoom), admin title links, the admin lede, page text on the Not allowed page. html, body, main, section, article, .comment, .comments, .body and .replies never set a font-size.

type.name: --text-lg
type.use: Reader empty states (italic serif), .tally, blocked-account headings.

type.name: --text-xl
type.use: The brand wordmark is 1.5rem literal; --text-xl is the h2 inside the feedback letter card and the admin h2 section heads.

type.name: --text-2xl
type.use: Reader section heads (Comments, Thread) and archive titles, in serif 600.

type.name: --text-3xl
type.use: Admin page titles in the page head and the Not allowed h1, in serif 600.

type.name: --text-display
type.use: Reader page titles (the report title, All reports, hband on the empty home, the report title on the branch page), in serif 600.

type.name: weights
type.use: 400 for reading text, inputs and hints. 500 for nav and sidebar links, the composer label and reaction counts. 600 for every serif heading (Sitka draws a true semibold; Charter and Georgia take their bold), buttons, labels, disclosures, logins, the author's name, badges, pills, th, dt. 700 only for the brand.

type.name: --leading
type.use: Body, comment and letter bodies, textareas, notices. Butterick's 120 to 145% plus a little air for a narrow serif column on screen.

type.name: --leading-tight
type.use: Buttons, inputs, bylines, nav, the table, admin headings, archive titles.

type.name: --leading-display
type.use: Reader h1, and line-height 1.2 for serif h2s.

type.name: tracking
type.value: display -0.015em; --text-3xl and --text-2xl -0.01em; archive date eyebrow and table headers .06em uppercase; eyebrow h3 .06em uppercase; badge and pill .02em
type.use: Tightens large serif type and opens the small uppercase labels (5 to 12% for caps, per Butterick).

type.name: numerals
type.value: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums in the admin only (table, dd, .tally)
type.use: The reader pages keep proportional figures, so counts read as words, not as a ledger.

type.name: headings
type.value: text-wrap: balance on h1, h2 and h3
type.use: Long report titles break into even lines.

space.name: --space-1
space.use: Byline to body (the pinned .body margin), gap between sidebar items, the tray's top margin.

space.name: --space-2
space.use: Label to its field, gap between buttons, byline gap, chevron to text, header nav row gap, avatar to the author's name.

space.name: --space-3
space.use: Textarea to its button, notice and tray padding, the gap around the reactions dots, table cell padding, the reply rule's gap.

space.name: --space-4
space.use: h2 to its content, gap between cards and form rows, nested comment spacing, own-letter separators.

space.name: --space-5
space.use: Archive row padding, header nav column gap, the page-head bottom padding, dl column gap.

space.name: --space-6
space.use: Composer to the first comment; admin page head to content.

space.name: --space-7
space.use: Vertical padding of page-level empty states.

space.name: --space-8
space.use: The Not allowed page's top padding and main's bottom padding.

space.name: --space-section
space.use: Between reader sections (reactions to the letter card, letter card to Comments). margin-top longhands only.

space.name: --space-head
space.use: From the reader meta line to the report frame, and from the All reports title to the archive list.

space.name: --panel-pad
space.use: Inside the feedback letter card, admin cards and the upload form.

space.name: --control-h
space.use: Minimum height of every button, input, select and file-selector button.

space.name: --disclosure-h
space.use: Minimum height of summaries, the replies toggle and the continue link: above the 24px WCAG 2.2 target and calm in a deep thread.

space.name: gutter
space.use: The side gutter at every width, 32px in total, which the 360px thread model reads. main's shorthand stays literal; other vertical values are padding-top or padding-bottom longhands.

space.name: page widths
space.value: main.reader 72rem (70rem of content); .admin 72rem (13rem sidebar plus main); plain main 38rem
space.use: Centred columns. The header's inset puts its content on the same 70rem edges.

space.name: title measure
space.use: Centred reader h1 and meta line.

space.name: report sheet
space.use: The reader report frame: wider than the text, like a feature, while a prose report stays readable.

space.name: reading measure
space.value: 38rem (608px), literal, centred with margin-left and margin-right auto
space.use: About 70 to 75 characters of 16px serif: the reactions row, the letter card, Comments, the branch thread, the archive list and its footnote, and reader empty states.

space.name: admin measure
space.use: Admin cards, the dl, the inbox, moderation, blocked accounts, the lede and the upload form, left-aligned. The table and the preview frame take the full width.

space.name: header inset
space.use: Puts the header's content on the edges of the 70rem reader column and of the .admin container.

space.name: thread geometry (unchanged)
space.use: A level-5 body keeps 259px at 375 and 244px at 360.

space.name: comment rhythm
space.value: top-level comments 1.25rem margin plus 1.25rem padding-top and a hairline between them; replies 1rem apart
space.use: Top-level comments read as separate turns in a conversation; replies stay close to what they answer.

shape.name: --radius-sm
shape.use: Inputs, selects, textareas, the file-selector button's box, sidebar items, inline code, the confirm tray, the report frames, inline empty states, the right corners of notices.

shape.name: --radius
shape.use: The feedback letter card, admin cards, the dl, the upload form, page-level empty states.

shape.name: --radius-pill
shape.use: Every button (primary, neutral, quiet, danger, and the file-selector button), badges and status pills.

shape.name: hairline
shape.value: 1px solid, colour var(--divider) through a *-color longhand
shape.use: Header bottom edge, the reactions row's top rule, separators between top-level comments, archive rows and own letters, table rules, card edges, the page-head rule and the report frame edge.

shape.name: control edge
shape.use: Neutral buttons, inputs, selects, textareas and the file-selector button. Primary and danger buttons take a 1px edge in their own fill colour.

shape.name: notice edge
shape.value: 4px solid on the left only, in the notice's role colour

shape.name: reply rule
shape.value: 2px solid var(--accent) on the left only
shape.use: The author's reply to a letter (.feedback-reply), drawn like a pull-quote rule in pine.

shape.name: thread line
shape.value: 1px solid var(--thread) on the left only

shape.name: tray edge
shape.use: The open confirm tray of Remove and Block.

shape.name: focus ring
shape.use: Every :focus-visible element; fields also turn their border --focus. Never removed.

shape.name: avatar ring
shape.use: Avatars, so a dark or missing image still reads as a circle. The only box-shadow.

shape.name: shadows
shape.use: Elevation is paper, hairline and --surface. No translucent colour, no opacity, no filter anywhere.

shape.name: pressed
shape.use: Every button and the file-selector button while :active. No transitions or animations.

components.name: Site header
components.look: A transparent bar on the paper: no fill, 1px --divider bottom edge, min-height 4rem, padding --space-3 top and bottom and max(1rem, (100% - 70rem) / 2) at the sides; flex, wrapping, justify-content space-between, align-items center, gap --space-2 / --space-5. Brand on the left. The nav on the right is a wrapping flex row (gap --space-2 / 1.25rem), --text-sm, min-width 0: 'All reports' and the owner's 'Admin' as nav links (--text, weight 500, no underline), the 24px Avatar, '.who' (--text-muted, overflow-wrap anywhere, min-width 0), and Sign out as a Quiet button. Signed out: 'All reports' and 'Sign in with GitHub' as a Primary button. .site-header form margin 0. The "header" define's markup is unchanged.
states: signed out: All reports, then the pine pill 'Sign in with GitHub'
signed-in reader: All reports, avatar, muted 'Signed in as @login', quiet Sign out
owner: the same with Admin before Sign out
nav link hover: 1px underline at offset .25em
keyboard focus: the 2px --focus ring at offset 2px on the brand, each link and Sign out
39-character login: the who text breaks anywhere and the page never widens
brand only (Not allowed page): the bar holds the Brand alone
phone: the nav wraps onto a second row under the brand, left-aligned

components.name: Brand
components.look: 'hband' as a wordmark: --font-serif, 1.5rem, weight 700, letter-spacing -0.01em, line-height 1, --text, no underline, no mark or icon.
states: hover: 2px underline at offset .2em
keyboard focus: the focus ring

components.name: Author byline
components.look: The reader page's lead line under the title: p.meta, centred, max-width 44rem, margin 0 auto --space-head, --font-sans --text-sm --text-muted, ordinary inline flow so it wraps centred. It reads: [avatar] login · Published 2 January 2026 · Link to this report. span.author: --text, weight 600, overflow-wrap anywhere. Its .avatar is 1.75rem (28px), margin-right --space-2, vertical-align middle. The permalink is the Meta link. The new markup is set out in for_the_builder; without an author row the line starts at 'Published'.
states: author known: avatar, name, date, permalink on one centred line at 1280
author unknown (no users row for the owner, or the read failed): date and permalink only, never an error
no publish date: author · Link to this report
avatar missing or refused: the plain --surface-2 circle with its ring
phone: wraps onto two centred lines; a long login breaks anywhere

components.name: Admin sidebar

First child of .admin: flex 1 1 13rem, display flex, flex-wrap wrap, gap .125rem, padding 2rem 1rem 0. Each link: display flex, align-items center, flex 1 1 calc((20rem - 100%) * 999), white-space nowrap, min-height 2.25rem, padding 0 --space-3, --radius-sm, --text-sm weight 500 --text, no underline. No fill or edge on the nav.

hover: --surface-2 fill
pressed: colour --accent-hover
keyboard focus: the focus ring
desktop: a 13rem column left of the page
phone: one row of three items above the page head; below 20rem of nav width they stack

components.name: Page head (admin)
components.look: div.page-head: flex, wrap, align-items center, justify-content space-between, gap --space-3 / --space-5, margin 0 0 --space-6, padding-bottom --space-5, 1px --divider bottom edge. Optional .crumb (Back link, --text-sm, flex-basis 100%, margin 0). h1: --font-serif, --text-3xl, weight 600, letter-spacing -0.01em, line-height --leading-tight, margin 0, flex 1 1 18rem, min-width 0. The page's main action (a.primary or a form with its button) at the right: flex none, margin 0.

/admin/blocked: the title alone

components.name: Link
components.look: Written as :where(a): --link, 1px underline at offset .2em; visited unchanged, never purple. Variants: nav and sidebar link (--text, no underline); title link (archive h2, admin table first column: --text, no underline); meta link (.meta a: --text-muted, underlined); back link (.back: inline-flex, a left-pointing ::before chevron); continue link (.continue: --text-sm, weight 600, inline-flex, min-height --disclosure-h).

components.name: Primary button
components.look: The one main action, a pine pill: --accent fill, 1px --accent edge, --on-accent text, --font-sans --text-sm weight 600, line-height --leading-tight, min-height --control-h, padding 0 1.125rem, --radius-pill, cursor pointer. Bound to .primary, .signin, .comments > form button, .reply form button, .feedback form button, .feedback-inbox form button, form[action='/admin/reports'] button. Anchors (.signin, a.primary) are inline-flex, align-items center, no underline.

Never sets display. Thumbs up, Thumbs down, Take back my vote, Unpublish, Unblock, Sign out on the Not allowed page.

pressed: edge --text-muted, translateY(1px)
keyboard focus: the focus ring

components.name: Danger button
components.look: Primary metrics with a --danger fill, 1px --danger edge, --on-danger text. Bound to button.danger, .remove form button, .block form button, form[action$='/delete'] button. Written after the primary rule.
states: hover: --danger-hover fill and edge
pressed: translateY(1px)
keyboard focus: the pine ring

components.name: Disclosure
components.look: A quiet text action for summary and button.toggle: no fill, no border, padding 0, min-height --disclosure-h, --font-sans --text-sm weight 600 --text-muted. summary keeps display flex, align-items center, width fit-content, max-width 100%, list-style none, hidden ::-webkit-details-marker. .toggle never sets display; the hidden guard owns it. The chevron (::before, content '', .45em square, 2px right and bottom borders in currentColor, rotate(-45deg), margin-right --space-2) is drawn on .toggle and on generic summaries. The Reply, Remove and Block summaries draw none (::before content none), so they read as words, not as a tree. details[open] > summary::before and .toggle[aria-expanded='true']::before rotate(45deg).
states: closed: muted 'Reply'; 'Show replies' with a right chevron
open: an open Reply summary turns --accent; 'Hide replies' with a down chevron
hover: --text with an underline at .2em, no fill

components.name: Two-step destructive control

Step 2, the open form, a confirm tray: --danger-soft fill, 1px --danger edge, --radius-sm, padding --space-3, margin --space-1 0 --space-3, width fit-content, max-width 100%, holding the Danger button. No display on the details.

layout:
html carries --bg. The Site header spans the full width on the paper, with its content inset by max(1rem, (100% - 70rem) / 2) and a hairline under it.

**Reader pages** (main.reader): main is centred, at most 72rem, padding 1.5rem 1rem 4rem (literal), plus padding-top clamp(2rem, 1rem + 3vw, 4rem) as a longhand.
- Report and home: the serif title centred in 44rem, then the Author byline, then the report sheet (60rem, centred).
- Then one centred 38rem reading column holds the Reactions row, the Letter card and Comments, separated by --space-section.
- Branch page: the title, then the centred 'Back to the full report' link, then the 'Thread' section in the 38rem column.
- All reports: main.reader:has(> .legend) is display flex, flex-direction column. Its h1 has margin-bottom --space-head; the archive list and any empty state follow in the 38rem column (width 100%, auto side margins). The .legend takes order 1, so it becomes a footnote after the list: width 100%, max-width 38rem, margin 2.5rem auto 0, text-align left, --text-sm muted. The writing leads and the counting note follows.

**Admin pages**: below the header, div.admin (at most 72rem, centred, flex, wrap, align-items flex-start) holds the Admin sidebar (flex 1 1 13rem) and main[data-hband-admin] (flex 999 1 40rem, max-width none, margin 0, padding 1.5rem 1rem 4rem, padding-top 2rem). Each main opens with the Page head. Cards and forms are 44rem; the table and preview are full width.

**Other pages** (Not allowed): body > main is centred at 38rem with padding-top --space-8.

**Rhythm**:
- 48 to 64px between reader sections; 40px from the frame to the reactions rule.
- 2.5rem plus a hairline between top-level comments; 16px between replies; 4px from a byline to its words.
- 24px of padding in each archive row.
- 40px above an admin h2; 32px under the admin page head; 16px between cards and form rows; 12px from a field to its button; 8px from a label to its field.

**Phone width.** There are no at-rules, so nothing switches at a breakpoint; everything changes by wrapping and clamp():
- The header nav wraps under the brand.
- Titles shrink from 56px to 36px and section gaps from 64px to 48px.
- The report sheet becomes 343px wide.
- The reactions line and its pills wrap, and the byline wraps centred.
- The letter card's padding drops to 16px.
- On admin pages the sidebar becomes one row above the page head, the page-head action wraps under the title, and table cell padding drops to 6px.
- Every long word (logins, slugs, the SHA-256, unbroken comment bodies) breaks anywhere.

At 375 the content is 343px and a level-5 comment keeps 259px (244px at 360). No screen scrolls sideways.
foundation:
**The stylesheet.** Every visual decision lives in internal/server/static/site.css, served same-origin at /static/site.css from staticFS under the unchanged siteCSP (style-src 'self'; no webfont, no url()). The file runs in this order:
1. Line 1: `:root { color-scheme: light dark; }`.
2. A second :root with every token. Colours are light-dark(#hex6, #hex6). The font families and the type, space and shape scales come next, under the same names as today, so internal/server/stylesheet_test.go's nonColourTokens and pairRows hold unedited.
3. The `[hidden]:not(:target) { display: none !important; }` guard.
4. The element baseline.
5. The components, bound to today's classes, elements and form actions, plus the admin classes already in the markup (.admin, .admin-nav, .page-head, .crumb, .pill, .pill-*, .lede, .empty, .empty-inline, .upload) and one new reader class, .author.
6. The page parts, keeping every pinned rule text.

There is no at-rule, so dark mode comes only from light-dark() under color-scheme, which follows the visitor's prefers-color-scheme.

**The shell.** The one stylesheet link is in the "head" partial of internal/layout/templates/base.html (embedded by internal/layout/layout.go as layout.FS). "page-start" and "page-end" open and close every page:
- internal/server parses them first through parsePages() in internal/server/router.go. Its "header" and "admin-nav" defines live in internal/server/templates/layout.html.
- internal/auth/owner.go parses layout.FS, then internal/auth/templates/forbidden.html, which defines its brand-only "header".

**The pages.** No page has its own head, style block or style attribute:
- report.html, branch.html and all_reports.html take the look through the shell. report.html gains the author span in its meta line.
- admin.html, admin_report.html and admin_blocked.html wrap their main in div.admin after admin-nav.
- forbidden.html takes the shell and its own brand-only header.
- comments.html and feedback.html are partials of report.html and branch.html.

A later page gets the look by opening with page-start and closing with page-end; a later admin page also takes .admin and admin-nav. A later colour is a new light-dark() token in :root plus a row in TestStylesheetTokens.
